cues.text: For Alex, the next question is no longer where to find work.
He opens the assigned task, checks the original request, and describes the work completed.
In our cafe example, the tables are prepared and the event supplies arranged.
The submission gives Maya a checkpoint for review.
This makes Do Well a productivity application as well as a marketplace: it follows the work beyond the application.
The production implementation includes milestones and optional image attachments.
Those are not available in this isolated demo, so the recording uses text.
A photo, where supported, provides supporting information, not automatic proof that every requirement was satisfied.
The employer still reviews the result.
Production cached views and saved drafts help during weak connectivity; they do not mean every action silently synchronizes in the background.
